title: Single source of truth for the database schema

demand.statement: Finding API-M4: the FastAPI lifespan calls SQLModel.metadata.create_all, so production Postgres can diverge from Alembic. The production Supabase database was created by Supabase migrations, has no alembic_version table, and revision c7a1b5e0d942 was already applied by hand. Register this as the next Retornatus Change after C-0007, open one pull request titled chore(db): single source of truth for schema, and do not merge it.
